name: intelliprompter-monorepo
description: Intelliprompter: a teleprompter that checks off your talking points as you say them.
author: Stefan Butnaru

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.desktop: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run start -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:win: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run dist:win -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:mac: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run dist:mac -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build:linux: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run dist:linux -w apps/desktop
